dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:6401.text: The appearance of fire. Formed from 火, with 弗 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6402.text: The appearance of fire. Formed from 火, with 翏 indicating the sound. The Lost Book of Zhou says: 'Its taste is acrid but not scorching.'

shuowen:6403.text: The appearance of fire. Formed from 火, with abbreviated 𨳌 indicating the sound. Read like 粦.

shuowen:6404.text: The color of fire. Formed from 火, with 雁 indicating the sound. Read like 鴈.

shuowen:6405.text: Firelight. Formed from 火, with 頃 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6406.text: Fire flying upward. Formed from 火, with 龠 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to burn.

shuowen:6407.text: Fire flying upward. Formed from 火, with 㶾 indicating the sound. Read like 摽.

shuowen:6408.text: Fire's heat. Formed from 火, with 高 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'It will bring much scorching heat.'

shuowen:6409.text: Crossed pieces of wood burning. Formed from 火, with 交 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6410.text: Slight heat. Formed from 火, with 干 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'My troubled heart burns.'

shuowen:6411.text: Something kindled to hold fire. Formed from 火, with 焦 indicating the sound. The Rites of Zhou says: 'With bright fire, kindle the torch.'

shuowen:6412.text: What remains after wood is burned. Formed from 火, with abbreviated 岸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6413.text: Bundled charcoal. Formed from 火, with abbreviated 差 indicating the sound. Read like 齹.

shuowen:6414.text: Wood crossed and burning together. Formed from 火, with abbreviated 教 indicating the sound. Read like 狡.

shuowen:6415.text: Fire vapor. Formed from 火, with 犮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6416.text: The remaining embers of dead fire. Formed from 火 and 又. 又 is a hand: once fire is extinguished, it can be handled.

shuowen:6417.text: Ash or soot, 炱煤. Formed from 火, with 台 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6418.text: Fire in a basin. Formed from 火, with 畏 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6419.text: To bank or preserve fire. Formed from 火, with 息 indicating the sound. Also said of extinguishing fire.

shuowen:6420.text: A portable stove. Formed from 火, with 圭 indicating the sound. Read like 冋.

shuowen:6421.text: A portable stove. Formed from 火, with 甚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6422.text: To cook. Formed from 火, with 單 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'Heat it with firewood.'

shuowen:6423.text: To cook. Formed from 火, with abbreviated 吹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6424.text: To burn or roast. Formed from 火, with 共 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Alas, roasting over the stove.'

shuowen:6425.text: To cook the meal quickly. Formed from 火, with 齊 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6426.text: To roast. Formed from 火, with 喜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6427.text: To simmer or fry. Formed from 火, with 前 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6428.text: To dry-fry. Formed from 火, with 敖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6429.text: To roast meat with its hair on. Formed from 火, with 包 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6430.text: To roast meat, warming it with a low fire. Formed from 火, with 衣 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6431.text: To put fish in a tube and roast it. Formed from 火, with 曾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6432.text: To dry meat with fire. Formed from 火, with 稫 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6433.text: To scorch. Formed from 火, with 暴 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6434.text: To roast dry. Formed from 火, with 昜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6435.text: To scorch. Formed from 火, with 隺 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6436.text: Cooked through. Formed from 火, with 蘭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6437.text: Cooked soft or thoroughly. Formed from 火, with 靡 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6438.text: To press downward from above. Formed from 𡰥, with 又 holding fire, to press and stretch silk fabric.

shuowen:6439.text: Heating a divination turtle without producing a crack-pattern. Formed from 火 and 龜. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'The turtle was heated but gave no crack-pattern.' Read like 焦.

shuowen:6440.text: To scorch. Formed from 火, with 久 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6441.text: To roast. Formed from 火, with 勺 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6442.text: To melt and refine metal. Formed from 火, with 柬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6443.text: A courtyard torch, a fire for illumination. Formed from 火, with 蜀 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6444.text: To burn hemp stalks. Formed from 火, with 悤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6445.text: The burnt remainder of a torch. Formed from 火, with 也 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6446.text: The remainder of a fire. Formed from 火, with 聿 indicating the sound. Alternatively, firewood.

shuowen:6447.text: To harden a blade. Formed from 火, with 卒 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6448.text: To bend and straighten wood. Formed from 火 and 柔; 柔 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:6449.text: To burn fields. Formed from 火 and 棥; 棥 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:6450.text: A break occurring when fire bends a carriage's rim or framework; the source records 車網, making the technical wording uncertain. Formed from 火, with 兼 indicating the sound. The Rites of Zhou says: 'When bending the rim, let the outside not crack.'

shuowen:6451.text: To set fire. Formed from 火, with 尞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6452.text: Fire flying upward. Formed from 火; the source says 纳 has the same conception as 𠨧, an obscure component explanation.

shuowen:6453.text: Scorched. Formed from 火, with 曹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6454.text: Damaged by fire. Formed from 火, with 雥 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6455.text: Heavenly fire is called 烖. Formed from 火, with 𢦏 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6456.text: Fire vapor or smoke. Formed from 火, with 垔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6457.text: 焆焆 is the appearance of smoke. Formed from 火, with 肙 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6458.text: Pent-up smoke. Formed from 火, with 昷 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6459.text: The appearance of looking toward a fire. Formed from 火, with 皀 indicating the sound. Read like 馰 in 馰顙.

shuowen:6460.text: Fire's heat. Formed from 火, with 覃 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6461.text: Bright. Formed from 火, with 𦎫 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'Shining over heaven and earth.'

shuowen:6462.text: Bright. Formed from 火, with 丙 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6463.text: Bright. Formed from 火, with 卓 indicating the sound. The Book of Zhou says: 'Clearly perceive the minds of the worthy men of the three realms.'

shuowen:6464.text: Bright. Formed from 火, with 昭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6465.text: Richly red. Formed from 火, with 韋 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'The red tube gleams.'

shuowen:6466.text: Abundant fire. Formed from 火 and 多.

shuowen:6467.text: Brilliant light. Formed from 火, with 習 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Glittering things move at night.'

shuowen:6468.text: Brilliant. Formed from 火, with 昱 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6469.text: To illuminate. Formed from 火, with 翟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6470.text: Radiance. Formed from 火, with 軍 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6471.text: 煌 means radiance. Formed from 火, with 皇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6472.text: Radiant. Formed from 火, with 昆 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6473.text: Light or radiance. Formed from 火, with 冋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6474.text: Brilliant or abundant. Formed from 火, with 曅 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Flashing thunder and lightning.'

shuowen:6475.text: A fire's opening or gate, according to the recorded 火門 gloss. Formed from 火, with 閻 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6476.text: Glittering. Formed from 火, with 玄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6477.text: Bright. Formed from 火 above 人, a person, conveying brightness.

shuowen:6478.text: Warm. Formed from 火, with 埶 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6479.text: Abundant or intense. Formed from 火, with 戠 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6480.text: Heat within. Formed from 火, with 奥 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6481.text: Warm. Formed from 火, with 爰 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6482.text: Warm. Formed from 火, with 耎 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6483.text: To appear or be visible. Formed from 火 and 日.

shuowen:6484.text: Dry. Formed from 火, with 亢 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6485.text: Dry. Formed from 火, with 喿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6486.text: To extinguish. Formed from 火 and 戌. Fire dies at 戌, and yang vital energy is exhausted upon reaching 戌. The Odes says: 'Illustrious royal Zhou: Baosi destroyed it.'

shuowen:6487.text: Drought vapor. Formed from 火, with 告 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6488.text: To illuminate broadly all over. Formed from 火, with 壽 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6489.text: The title of the official who obtains fire from the sun. Raising fire is called 爟. The Rites of Zhou says: 'The Si Guan administers the regulations for the use of fire.' Formed from 火, with 雚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6490.text: A beacon, a watch-post signal: when the frontier is alarmed, fire is raised. Formed from 火, with 逢 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6491.text: A reed torch, for purification. Formed from 火, with 爵 indicating the sound. Lü Buwei says: when Tang obtained Yi Yin, he purified him with raised torch-fire and anointed him with a sacrificial boar's blood.

shuowen:6492.text: To dry by exposure and fire. Formed from 火, with 彗 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6493.text: Dry. Formed from 火, with 巸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6494.text: Drought vapor. Formed from 火, with 蟲 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6495.text: Blazing intensely. Formed from 火, with 扇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6496.text: To scorch. Formed from 火, with 各 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6497.text: 灼爍 means light or brilliance. Formed from 火, with 樂 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6498.text: 燦爤 is a bright and clear appearance. Formed from 火, with 粲 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6499.text: Firelight. Formed from 火, with 奐 indicating the sound.

shuowen:6500.text: Firelight rising upward. Formed from repeated 火. All characters in this group are formed from 炎.
